title: Kagamine Len — Kindness In A Ribbon〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I hope Kanade and the others visit today...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I heard that she hasn't been able to work on their music with the others lately...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(But she must be feeling so lonely...
If she could just come over here to where Miku is...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?
Should I try talking to him...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I think someone just came...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Is it them?
I hope Mafuyu's also here.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, wait... The other day, Mafuyu and KAITO sort of...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If Mafuyu and KAITO see each other again...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-If Mafuyu is with them...
Please try not to say anything mean to her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mean?
I was only telling her what she needed to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu was so distraught last time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because you lot have been babying her too much...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At this rate, nothing is going to change. Do you plan on extending her suffering?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But...!
D-Does it really have to be now...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Kanade and the others...
They said that it's been over a week since they last worked with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Making music with the others meant so much to her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But she must be in so much pain since she can't even do that now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So...
Telling her now to “open her eyes” seems...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kanade. She wants to hear what we think of her new song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They also mentioned that they'll be throwing an after-party to celebrate their new song being uploaded. Mafuyu's supposed to go...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She is...? That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, Len, you seem to really dislike the thought of Mafuyu feeling any pain...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? I mean, it never feels good...
And my chest always gets so cold...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I also get that feeling bad for her won't actually make her feel any better...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean I'll never really be able to help her...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe that's entirely up to you, Len...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mafuyu herself likely doesn't know...
But myself and the others are all here because she wished it so as the owner of these feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, how we interact with her is a different story. As such, our specific roles aren't quite so clear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nonetheless, Len, I believe you should do as you please. Like how you stopped KAITO earlier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We don't have to all agree...?
Shouldn't we work together to help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, I think it's better if we don't agree...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Us, this SEKAI...
We were called here at a time when Mafuyu was about to lose herself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why I feel that we should all just be ourselves and maintain our individuality.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, who does that make me...?
